name: Your Birthday
overview: Scripture acknowledges birthdays as notable occasions, as seen in Genesis 40:20 where Pharaoh's birthday is marked by a feast. The Bible also emphasizes God's sovereign role in our creation and preservation, reminding us in Job 10:8 that the Lord has carefully fashioned each person. While celebrations are part of human experience, as Job's sons feasted on their special days (Job 1:4), the ultimate blessing and protection come from the Lord, who fights for His people (Exodus 14:14) and grants the desires of the heart (Psalms 20:4). Thus, birthdays can be occasions to reflect on God's providence and seek His continued blessing and care (Numbers 6:24).
